**Finding: compliant (IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data).**

The document meets the *preferred* IP position across four coordinated clauses:

- **§ 14.2** — Customer owns each Deliverable/work product created for it, with Vendor's present assignment of worldwide right, title and interest, plus personnel assignments and further assurances.
- **§ 14.3 / § 1.8** — Vendor retains only "Vendor Technology," defined as its pre-existing technology and expressly excluding Customer Data and Customer's pre-existing IP.
- **§ 13.2** (cross-referenced by § 14.3) — perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to embedded Vendor Technology, including modification and derivative works for Customer's business.
- **§ 14.1 / § 15.1** — Customer owns all Customer Data; Vendor's only right is to process it solely to provide, secure, support and improve the Services *for Customer* (service delivery, not independent exploitation), with sale, advertising, data-combination and model-training uses barred.
- **§ 14.4** — no joint ownership absent a separately signed instrument.

Noted in the rationale only (not redlined): ownership is "subject to payment of the applicable Fees," and § 14.4 permits a future opt-in to joint ownership by signed instrument. § 13.1's revocable Customer-only Services licence is a LICENSE-rule issue and was not double-flagged here. No redline proposed.
